# Qwen Code 0.21.14 currentness corpus

This secret-free identity corpus freezes host Qwen Code `0.21.2` and
official npm `@qwen-code/qwen-code` `0.21.14` before Swallowtail widens
the `qwen-code.package` claim.

Exact npm tarball and selected git-blob identities live in
`identity.json`. Selected flags, exact `--resume`, and the image-only
catalogue filter remain. The three selected source blobs are byte-identical
to `0.21.13`. `qwen sessions ps`, `/advisor`, and the live-session registry
stay unmapped.

Unpublished stable `0.20.2` stays a gap. Preview `0.21.14-preview.0` is
ignored. No provider prompt. No live catalogue. No live headless session.
The host install was not replaced. The frozen `0.21.13` corpus stays.

No fixture contains a credential, host path, account identity, provider
payload, or real session id.
